title: Qualify a manufacturing or fulfillment supplier
summary: Before relying on a supplier for a physical product or material customer-delivery function. An approved supplier qualification and controlled pilot with quality, capacity and continuity obligations assigned.
outcomes: An approved supplier qualification and controlled pilot with quality, capacity and continuity obligations assigned.
guidance: Start with the applicability facts and evidence listed in the first step. Resolve missing facts before authorizing the affected work. Completion requires the documented outcome, including tracked exceptions; starting an application or recording a task is not evidence of completion.
when: Before relying on a supplier for a physical product or material customer-delivery function.

parts.title: Define specifications and supplier requirements
parts.guidance: Prepare the product or service specification, volumes, traceability, quality, lead-time and location requirements. Identify critical materials and customer or regulatory constraints requiring specialist input.

execution.rationale: Prepare or reconcile the specified private evidence and documents; external changes and decisions use their own approved steps.

parts.title: Collect supplier capability evidence
parts.guidance: Verify the counterparty and gather capacity, quality, test, insurance and relevant certification evidence. Distinguish a supplier claim from independently checked evidence and record gaps.

execution.rationale: Prepare or reconcile the specified private evidence and documents; external changes and decisions use their own approved steps.

parts.title: Review quality, commercial and compliance risks
parts.guidance: Engineering, quality, operations and advisers assess samples, manufacturing controls, subcontracting, IP and local requirements. Decide which audit or site checks are needed and leave unverified capability visibly pending.

execution.rationale: The accountable person performs the decision, expert assessment or personal interaction described in this step. Supporting preparation does not authorize that act.

approval.scope: Review quality, commercial and compliance risks

parts.title: Approve terms and a controlled pilot
parts.guidance: Authorized parties finalize specifications, acceptance, change control, tooling ownership, remedies and continuity arrangements. Approve only a bounded pilot until the required evidence is complete.

execution.rationale: The accountable person performs the decision, expert assessment or personal interaction described in this step. Supporting preparation does not authorize that act.

approval.scope: Approve terms and a controlled pilot

parts.title: Accept the supplier or assign remediation
parts.guidance: Evaluate the pilot against agreed quality and delivery criteria. Record the approved scope, unresolved corrective actions and review schedule, with an alternative plan for critical dependencies.

execution.rationale: The accountable person performs the physical work and checks described in this step. Supporting preparation does not authorize that act.

approval.scope: Accept the supplier or assign remediation

verify.how: An approved supplier qualification and controlled pilot with quality, capacity and continuity obligations assigned.

notes.text: This is an operational coordination guide. Confirm the applicable company facts, contracts and jurisdictions before acting. Qualified advisers own legal, tax, safety or regulatory determinations and any required professional work. The cited authorities describe their named jurisdictions or frameworks; their rules are not asserted for other countries. External actions require approval for the specific action.
Editorial status: operational draft. Source pages checked on 2026-10-29. No case-specific legal review, professional assurance or completed execution is claimed.
